selection_rationale: Task .1 is final-audit PASS, documented, merged, backed up, and synchronized
Task .2 is the next compiled atomic dependency and does not require Task .3 chat transport
The approved Spec already locks VALID, INVALID, and UNVERIFIED key-state semantics
required_acceptance_focus: OpenRouter credentials use only the Janus-Projekt/openrouter keyring namespace
save and replace perform authenticated content-free key-status validation
only authenticated success yields VALID; authentication rejection yields INVALID; incomplete technical validation yields UNVERIFIED
INVALID and UNVERIFIED remain fail-closed without deleting the stored key or selection state
temporary network/provider/model failures do not automatically invalidate a previously VALID key
save, replace, and delete do not read or mutate credentials for any other provider
API, UI, logs, errors, fixtures, and evidence never expose the raw key
no chat transport, model selection, telemetry, real key, or production activation is introduced
required_test_focus: backend contract tests for save, replace, delete, authenticated success, auth rejection, timeout/network failure, and provider credential isolation
negative assertions that raw keys never appear in response bodies, logs, exceptions, or evidence
headed settings E2E for masked storage state and visible non-sensitive VALID, INVALID, and UNVERIFIED states
regression for existing API-key settings and the separate ChatGPT connection card
Python and JavaScript syntax checks plus scoped git diff check
verified_local_seams: backend/api/routers/system.py already owns /api/keys and uses keyring service Janus-Projekt with provider-lowercase entries
frontend/js/settings.js and frontend/index.html own the existing provider-key settings surface
all listed existing Task .2 files are clean on master before refinement; the two new test paths do not exist yet
forbidden_behaviors: No live OpenRouter request or credential access
No raw or synthetic credential-shaped value in returned evidence
No chat transport, provider fallback, model selection, telemetry, Task .3-.6, Git, release, or production authority
No authoritative handoff write by OpenRouter
